entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: A realm of Kaldheim of fire, demons, vampiric dragons and constant warfare.

entities.name: Bloodcrag
entities.description: A volcano filled with blood that is the source of all demons.

entities.name: Fields of Elskul
entities.description: Battlegrounds where rival demon jarls fight.

entities.name: Vaults of Hellir
entities.description: Chambers holding plunder from other realms.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: Gods who birthed the elven race and sealed the demons into Immersturm.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: Gods who defeated the Einir and resealed Immersturm with runic magic.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: Planeswalker on Immersturm who failed to stop Tibalt.

entities.name: Tyvar Kell
entities.description: Planeswalker on Immersturm who failed to stop Tibalt.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A devilish planeswalker who created a Doomskar.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: A rift event through which demons attacked another realm.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: Leader of the demons who streamed through the rift.

entities.name: Valla
entities.description: A plane that split off from Kaldheim and has an Immersturm remnant.

events.summary: The Einir seal the demons into Immersturm; after the Skoti defeat the Einir the relics are lost and the Skoti reseal it with runes.
events.quote: The Skoti used runic magic to reseal Immersturm

events.summary: Kaya and Tyvar fail to stop Tibalt from creating a Doomskar, and thousands of demons led by Varragoth attack another realm.
events.quote: thousands of demons streamed through a giant rift in space to attack another realm

relations.quote: Immersturm is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim

relations.note: The Skoti challenged and defeated the Einir.
relations.quote: When the Skoti challenged the Einir's supremacy and defeated them

relations.note: Led the demons through the rift (leader of the raiding demons).
She could not stop him creating a Doomskar.
relations.quote: unable to prevent the devilish Tibalt from creating a Doomskar
